A UPS Access Point in Spring is **inside CVS** at **24802 Aldine Westfield Rd, Spring, TX 77373**.

Services provided:

- **Drop off packages**, including returns, that are already packaged with a printed shipping label.
- **Pick up packages** shipped directly or redirected to this Access Point.
- **Evening and weekend availability** for pickups and drop-offs.

Bring an ID matching the delivery information when collecting a package.

**Contact:** (800) 742-5877  
[UPS locations in Spring](https://locations.ups.com/us/en/tx/spring/)
